verdict.rationale: mParticle documents per-destination forwarding rules driven by consent and CCPA opt-out state (e.g., 'Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present'), plus Consent Filters and a page on transforming data as it leaves the platform, so it gives some per-destination control over data flow. The evidence covers only whole-event, consent-based gating plus a bare transformation title, not attribute-level PII handling. Missing for 10: documented hashing of PII per destination, masking of sensitive attributes, field-level attribute filtering per output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
